findingsFixed.issue: Prisma CLI 7.10.1 was paired with Client and PostgreSQL adapter 7.9.0.
findingsFixed.fix: Pin all three to 7.10.1 and enforce the invariant in stable/RC release tests.

findingsFixed.issue: Seven high development dependency entries came from one unpatched braces advisory through the otherwise unused shadcn CLI.
findingsFixed.fix: Vendor the exact shadcn 4.22.1 CSS with MIT attribution and a shipped license; remove CLI and its dependency chain. Full npm audit now reports zero vulnerabilities.

findingsFixed.issue: A fresh migrated database contains a placeholder local-admin identity, causing a configured custom initial username/email to be ignored and login to return 401.
findingsFixed.fix: Adopt configured identity only when the exact uninitialized migration placeholder has no credential; preserve initialized accounts and passwords on upgrade.

findingsFixed.issue: Release gates did not audit build-time dependencies.
findingsFixed.fix: Stable and RC validation now run npm audit --audit-level=high with development dependencies included.
